description: This header file declares functions for parsing and handling ComcastBatterySavingData structures related to Zigbee battery saving features, including function prototypes and include directives. It also includes licensing information.

methods.name: comcastBatterySavingDataParse
methods.description: Parses a buffer to extract ComcastBatterySavingData information. Returns a pointer to the data on success, or NULL on failure.

methods.name: comcastBatterySavingHelperUpdateResources
methods.description: Updates resources based on the ComcastBatterySavingData received from a device, identified by its EUI64.
